en.title: Hugo leaps to 2nd, Alexandre drops four spots
bullets: Michel (Les Ducks) holds the lead at 159 points, but Hugo (Crazy Blue Heelers) jumps to 2nd with 30 points last night. 🏆
Marjolaine (mchb) had the biggest night: 34 points. Alexandre (Éperviers de Sorel) slid four spots. Ouch.
Montreal beat Buffalo 4-3 in a shootout; Caufield (13 owners) scored, and so did Hutson. 🔥
McDavid, Draisaitl and Reinhart are each one goal away from 5. Keep an eye on them!
Pastrnak is a golden pick for just one participant; Eichel (13 points) has no owners; Chychrun is 4 games without a point. 🧊
